name: homestro_product_search
description: Search the Homestro Shopify catalog and return products with title, status, price, category, tags, variants, images, SEO and collections.

name: homestro_read_variants
description: Read one Homestro product including every variant, selected option values, SKUs and assigned images before changing anything. Use this first when variant names look like numbers or codes.

name: homestro_price_check
description: Check Homestro product economics: supplier cost up to 10 EUR, selling price at least 34.90 EUR, ratio at least 3x.

name: homestro_create_draft
description: Create a German Shopify product draft. Always DRAFT; never publishes.

name: homestro_optimize_product
description: Fully optimize an existing Homestro product while keeping it DRAFT. Read the variants first, then directly rename variant option values even when variants already have images. Never invent missing supplier data and never publish.

option_values.description: Variant option values to set directly. Use this for image-linked variants. Preserve images.
